plan: Drive: from City of Prince George, about 117 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Carney St, Hwy 16, Blackwater Rd, Five Dollar FSR.
Park: 53.1216, -122.92121, pull off on Five Dollar FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Five Dollar FSR stretch, 3.3 km one way. About 66 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-13, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
